body:
sleepwait() on sleepywait 0.3.0 hangs forever instead of pausing briefly and returning.

Repro: install sleepywait==0.3.0 and call sleepwait() — the process never comes back.
Expected: return after a short pause.
Environment: sleepywait 0.3.0, stock python3, no dependencies.
comments: Can confirm: sleepwait() with the default delay hangs my script.
A timeout wrapper is the only way to get control back.
title: sleepwait() never returns
